results.title: Register with valid data
results.steps: POST /auth/register username=qa3537d, valid e-mail, password Passw0rd!x
results.expected: 200, account created, token returned

results.title: Register with empty fields
results.steps: Submit the form with all fields empty
results.expected: 400, account not created, error names a field
results.actual: 400, Username must be 2-16 characters: letters, digits or underscore (field=username)

results.title: Register a duplicate username
results.steps: Register qa3537d again with a different e-mail
results.expected: Refused (4xx) with a username error

results.title: Register with a wrong e-mail format
results.steps: E-mail = not-an-email
results.expected: 400, e-mail field error

results.title: Register with a very long username (300 chars)
results.steps: Username of 300 letters
results.expected: 400, username error, no server error
results.actual: 400, Username must be 2-16 characters: letters, digits or underscore

results.title: Register with a too short password
results.steps: Password = 1
results.expected: 400, password error

results.title: Sign in with valid credentials
results.steps: POST /auth/login with the account from TC-01
results.expected: 200, session token

results.title: Sign in with a wrong password / unknown user
results.steps: Wrong password; then a user that does not exist
results.expected: Both refused with the same generic message
results.actual: 401 'Invalid username or password' / 401 'Invalid username or password'

results.title: Protected data without signing in
results.steps: GET /friends with no token
results.expected: 401, no data

results.title: Enter matchmaking
results.steps: Signed in, press Play (POST /matchmaking/join)
results.expected: State SEARCHING

results.title: Cancel matchmaking
results.steps: While searching, press Cancel
results.expected: State IDLE, player left the queue

results.title: Enter matchmaking while logged out
results.steps: POST /matchmaking/join without a token

results.title: Versus information after pairing
results.steps: Two players with equal rating press Play at the same time
results.expected: Matched; room shows both usernames and ratings

results.title: Time left to join is shown
results.steps: Open the assigned match (GET /rooms/{code})
results.expected: Response has the join deadline

results.title: Both players get the same map
results.steps: Both enter; compare the map of each player's state
results.expected: Same mapId and door titles for both
results.actual: A map 2, B map 2, same doors=True

results.title: Locked doors block the way to the finish
results.steps: Claim the finish with all doors still locked
results.expected: 409, 'Unlock all doors before reaching the exit'
results.actual: 409, Unlock all doors before reaching the exit

results.title: Open a door from far away
results.steps: Press E at the start, far from door 1
results.expected: 409, 'Walk up to the door first'
results.actual: 409, Walk up to the door first

results.title: Skip a door
results.steps: Try to open door 2 before door 1
results.expected: 409, 'Open the previous door first'

results.title: Teleport is refused (server-confirmed position)
results.steps: Report a position across the map in one step
results.expected: Position not accepted

results.title: Open door 1 at the door
results.steps: Walk to door 1, press E
results.expected: Challenge with statement, input/output, starter code; door timer running

results.title: Opponent sees my progress
results.steps: After walking, B reads the match state
results.expected: B's opponent position = A's latest accepted position

results.title: Submit empty code
results.steps: Press Submit with an empty editor
results.expected: 400, 'Write some code first'

results.title: Submit a wrong solution
results.steps: Submit the unchanged starter code
results.expected: passed=false, door stays locked, feedback shown

results.title: Countdown does not reset on resubmit
results.steps: Submit again (an endless loop) and compare the timer
results.expected: Time left keeps going down; endless loop stopped with a time-limit or type error
results.actual: 19s -> 17s, error=The parameter types of 'solve' do not fit the test data (expected a number, got [1, 5, 3, 9, 2])

results.title: Submit a correct solution
results.steps: Submit the catalog's reference solution
results.expected: passed=true, door 1 unlocked

results.title: Door opens by itself when the timer ends
results.steps: Open door 2 and wait without submitting (door time 20 s in this run)
results.expected: Door 2 unlocked for this player only

results.title: Finish the race
results.steps: All doors open, walk into the exit
results.expected: Match FINISHED, A is the winner

results.title: Both players see the result
results.steps: B opens the match after A finished
results.expected: B sees FINISHED, LOSS for B, normal finish

results.title: Rating changes once
results.steps: Read A's rating, then send the finish again
results.expected: Change shown (+ for A, - for B); a repeated finish does not change it again
results.actual: A delta 16, B delta -16; repeat finish 200, rating after repeat 1516

results.title: No-show is banned
results.steps: B is matched but never enters (join window 20 s in this run)
results.expected: Match ends as NO_SHOW, A wins, B is banned and cannot queue
results.actual: room=FINISHED, B queue: 403 You are banned from matches for 2 more minute(s) because of an absence

results.title: Reconnect before the deadline
results.steps: B stops for 12 s (limit 30 s), then reopens the match
results.expected: Match still PLAYING, B's state restored, no penalty

results.title: Disconnect too long = technical loss
results.steps: B stays away longer than 30 s
results.expected: Match ends once with reason ABSENCE, A wins

results.steps: Admin submits a challenge whose reference solution passes
results.expected: Published

results.steps: Same form with empty tests
results.expected: Blocked with a specific error
